title: AI Cyber Assurance Return — data file
description: One completed questionnaire from one reporting organisation, produced by the Download data file button. The file holds answers only: ratings are derived later in the governing body console, so nothing in this file reveals how answers are scored.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file format. The console accepts 2.x.

frameworkVersion.description: Version of the question set used to produce this return.

programme.description: Programme the return belongs to, taken from branding.js.

requestedBy.description: The governing body that issued the questionnaire.

period.description: Return cycle label, for example "2026 Annual Return".

declarationConfirmed.description: The respondent confirmed the answers are accurate and approved internally.

code.description: Register code such as E01, or OTHER when not on the register.

answers.description: One entry per answered question, keyed by question id such as A1 or D3. Unanswered questions are absent.

value.description: Yes/No questions use yes, no, unsure or na. List questions use the option value. Tick-box questions use an array of option values, ['none'] for none of them, or ['na']. Number questions use a number.

sectionNotes.description: Optional free-text comments keyed by section letter.

progress.description: How much of the questionnaire was completed. Counts only — no ratings.

demo.description: True for synthetic records generated by the console for demonstration.
